csv_scope_of_work: The Cheyenne and Arapaho Tribes is issuing this Request for Proposal (RFP) to solicit proposals from qualified firms to provide two interconnected scopes of professional services: (1) broadband engineering, grant support, and telecommunications planning services funded through Capital Project Funds (CPF) and the NTIA Tribal Broadband Connectivity Program (TBCP) Round II ( Part A ); and (2) development of a comprehensive Broadband & Telecommunications Roadmap that will serve as the Tribe s primary strategic and technical reference for broadband planning, investment, and decision-making over a three-to-five (3 5) year period
